member.name: M:Syncfusion.UITestHelpers.ExtendReport.UITestValidationTable.AppendFailedTestCase(System.String,System.Double,System.DateTime,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Appends a single failed test case entry to the Excel validation table. If the file does not exist, it creates a new workbook with headers. If the file already exists, it opens and appends a new row without replacing existing data.
member.param: Name of the failed test case.
Execution duration of the test in seconds.
Date and time when the test was executed.
Exception message and stack trace captured from the failed test.
Optional full path for the Excel file. If null, the file is placed in the report directory ().
